reason: LogicSkills is published as one fixed 1,500-item evaluation set and is not intended for training. A local label-blind partition provides bounded development evidence while retaining a fresh public-evaluation subset that cannot influence capability changes.
policy: Within each task and language stratum, sort by SHA-256 of the fixed seed, source filename, and source ID. The first 20 percent is fresh. Answer fields and input text are not partition inputs.
developmentVisibility: Only id, task, language, input, and output contract are returned to a development consumer. Reference formulas and validity indices remain host-only.
freshVisibility: The partition was frozen before execution. A later frozen candidate executed only the 60-member countermodel stratum under an aggregate-only protocol. The 240 symbolization and validity members remain unopened; no fresh item or oracle is exported to synthesis.
